links.outcome: GPT-4o stroke classification accuracy on held-out and external validation data versus registry gold standard
links.effect: External validation at Parkland: 98% accuracy (95% CI 0.97-0.99) for stroke type; sensitivity 0.98, specificity 0.97; ischemic subtype sensitivity 0.40 (cryptogenic) to 0.95 (small-vessel).
links.quote: GPT-4o achieved 98% accuracy (95% CI, 0.97-0.99) in classifying stroke type, where accuracy reflects the overall proportion of correctly classified patients.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM outputs across repeated queries
links.effect: Consistency analysis showed >99% agreement across repeated queries.
links.quote: Consistency analysis revealed >99% agreement across repeated queries.

unlisted_practices: Comparing zero-shot chain-of-thought, expert-guided, and instruction-based prompting strategies
Retrieval-augmented generation for extracting stroke subtypes from clinical notes

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM (GPT-4o) using RAG on retrospective EHR records for phenotyping stroke subtypes, comparing three prompting strategies (zero-shot chain-of-thought, expert-guided, and instruction-based) across an external validation cohort.
